objectives: “Econometrics is the set of tools by which economists analyze data. The objective of the course is for the student to learn how to estimate economic relationships, test economic theories, and evaluate government and business policy. Some computational problems may be assigned to solve by using statistical software package, such as R and STATA.“
content:
“1  Simple Regression
2  Multiple Regression
3  Inference for Multiple Regression
4  Dummy Variables in Multiple Regression
5  Further Issues in Multiple Regression
6  Regularization
7  Heteroskedasticity
8  Midterm
9  Time Series Regression I
10  Time Series Regression II
11  Endogeneity and Instrumental Variables Estimation
12  Panel Data
13  Binary Choice Models
14  Censoring, Truncation, and Selection
15  Experiments and Quasi-Experiments
16  Final
17  Self-Directed Learning
18  Self-Directed Learning“
books: “Introductory Econometrics: A Modern Approach, Jeffrey M. Wooldridge, 7th edition, 2019.“
grading_policy:
“▓Class Participation (出席率) 5％
▓Paper/Theses Writing (報告/論文) 15％
▓Midterm Test (期中考) 40％
▓Final Test (期末考) 40％“
